# 12-Month Diversification Plan
## Women's Legal Aid Organisation, Amman, Jordan

---

## Executive Summary

This plan recognises that a 5-person team (likely 2-3 lawyers, 1-2 support staff, 1 director) cannot execute a full-scale fundraising operation while maintaining service delivery. The strategy prioritises **high-probability, low-burden funding streams** and phases activities to protect casework quality.

---

## Month-by-Month Implementation

### **Months 1-2: Foundation & Rapid Wins**

| Activity | Lead | Time Commitment | Expected Outcome |
|----------|------|---------------|------------------|
| **Financial health check** | Director | 3 days | Clear runway calculation; identify minimum viable budget |
| **Map existing relationships** | Director + 1 staff | 2 days | List of 10-15 warm contacts (former trainees, board members, partner NGOs, university contacts) |
| **Register/update on Jordanian NGO platforms** | Support staff | 4 days | Active on [Nahno](https://nahno.org), [Jordan NGO Forum](http://jnof.org), UN OCHA's 3W |
| **Approach 2-3 Jordanian corporate foundations** | Director | 6 meetings | Zain, Orange, Arab Bank, or Crown Prince Foundation typically respond within 4-8 weeks |

**Realistic constraint:** Do NOT pursue competitive international grants yet—applications take 80+ hours with low success rates for unknown organisations.

---

### **Months 3-4: Local Revenue & Cost Reduction**

| Activity | Lead | Details |
|----------|------|---------|
| **Sliding-scale fee-for-service pilot** | Senior lawyer | Offer paid legal consultations to middle-class women (market rate JD 50-80/hour; sliding scale JD 15-40). Target: 10-15 paid hours/month by Month 6 |
| **Pro bono partnership with law firms** | Director | 2-3 Amman firms (Tilleke & Gibbins, Sharkas & Sharkas, or regional firms) provide free associate hours for discrete cases |
| **Reduce non-personnel costs 15%** | Director | Renegotiate rent, suspend non-essential subscriptions, review insurance |

**Critical decision point:** If runway <9 months, consider reducing to 4 FTE temporarily to extend operations.

---

### **Months 5-6: Regional & Arabic-Language Funding**

| Activity | Lead | Rationale |
|----------|------|-----------|
| **Apply to Arab regional funds** | Director + support | [Arab Human Rights Fund](https://ahrfund.org), [MENA Regional Office](https://www.unwomen.org/en/about-us/where-we-are/arab-states) (smaller, faster grants than European donors) |
| **Submit to Jordan-specific mechanisms** | Support staff | [Jordan Response Plan](https://www.jordanresponse.com) (if serving refugees), Ministry of Social Development small grants |
| **Develop 2-page Arabic case study** | All staff input | Concrete story + 3 statistics; use for all future approaches |

**Time allocation:** Maximum 8 hours/week collective fundraising effort; protect 80% for casework.

---

### **Months 7-9: Strategic Positioning**

| Activity | Lead | Details |
|----------|------|---------|
| **Secondary partnership with larger NGO** | Director | Become implementing partner for UN Women, IRC, or NRC on legal aid component. They bring funding; you bring expertise and access |
| **University clinic partnership** | Senior lawyer | Supervise law students from University of Jordan or Mutah; reduces caseload per staff member |
| **First "open" international grant application** | Director + support | Select ONE well-matched opportunity (e.g., [UN Trust Fund](https://www.unwomen.org/en/trust-fund), [Oak Foundation](https://oakfnd.org) if gender justice aligned). Success rate ~10%; budget 40 hours |

---

### **Months 10-12: Consolidation & Sustainability**

| Activity | Lead | Target |
|----------|------|--------|
| **Launch small individual giving** | Support staff | "Sustainer circle" of 20-30 Jordanian professionals giving JD 20-50/month via mobile payment (e.g., Cliq, PayPal) |
| **Document lessons for replication** | All | Position organisation as trainer/consultant to other Jordanian NGOs |
| **Secure 2+ funding sources covering 60%+ of budget** | Director | Diversification achieved if no single source >50% |

---

## Realistic Funding Mix at Month 12

| Source | % of Budget | Confidence |
|--------|-------------|------------|
| Fee-for-service / training | 15% | High |
| Local/regional foundations | 25% | Medium |
| International NGO partnership | 30% | Medium |
| Individual giving (small) | 10% | Low-Medium |
| Reserve/unsecured | 20% | — |

**Note:** Full replacement of 90% is unlikely in 12 months. The plan targets **organisational survival and credible diversification trajectory**, with 18-24 months needed for full stability.

---

## Risk Mitigation

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|
| Staff burnout | Cap fundraising at 8 hrs/week; hire short-term consultant (JD 1,500-2,500) for Month 6-9 if any funds secured |
| Casework quality drops | Transparent communication with clients; formalise waiting list; refer non-priority cases to Legal Aid Clinic (Jordan Bar Association) |
| No funds secured by Month 9 | Activate "hibernation plan": reduce to 2 FTE, secure storage for files, maintain registration, seek merger with compatible NGO |

---

## Immediate Actions (This Week)

1. **Director:** Calculate exact monthly burn rate and months of runway
2. **All staff:** 30-minute meeting to identify 3 personal/professional contacts who might open doors
3. **Support staff:** Update organisation profile on 2 Jordanian NGO directories

---

*This plan assumes the organisation is registered with Jordan's Ministry of Social Development and has basic financial systems. If not, Months 1-2 must include compliance remediation.*
